Same output from SPSS (with slight differences due to FIML vs. mean substitution methods of handling missing data).  

If you aren't analyzing the same exact data, you can't expect the same exact results. Given how much the results differ (more than slightly), I'm wondering how much missing data there are.  What is the N after listwise deletion?  Are these "Demog..." variables all dummy codes or continuous -- is it possible they are being treated as numeric in SPSS but as ordered categories in lavaan?  Providing your entire syntax (and perhaps a portion of your data if they aren't private) might be more helpful than only snippets of the output.  For example, I notice some parameter labels in your lavaan output -- does this indicate there are some across-group constraints that are not being made in the OLS model with SPSS?

Terry
